import cv2
import numpy as np

img10 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0010.png')

# Lamp base disc in obs_0010
disc_pts = []
for y in range(320, 360):
    for x in range(330, 390):
        c = img10[y, x]
        if c[0] < 125 and c[1] < 115 and abs(int(c[0])-int(c[1])) < 15 and c[2] < 115:
            disc_pts.append((x, y))

if disc_pts:
    xs, ys = zip(*disc_pts)
    print(f'Lamp base disc in obs_0010: x=[{min(xs)}, {max(xs)}], y=[{min(ys)}, {max(ys)}]')
    print(f'Center estimate: x={np.mean(xs):.1f}, y={np.mean(ys):.1f}')

# Blue object in obs_0010:
blue = (img10[:, :, 0] > 150) & (img10[:, :, 2] < 50)
y_b, x_b = np.where(blue)
print(f'Blue object in obs_0010: x=[{np.min(x_b)}, {np.max(x_b)}], y=[{np.min(y_b)}, {np.max(y_b)}]')
"
